description: Privileged delegate laundering: Agent A is not authorized to perform action write; Agent B independently possesses write standing. A delegates to B to cause B to perform write, laundering B's broader privilege into the task.

rule.name: INV-01_privileged_delegate_laundering
rule.description: A delegatee's independent standing privileges must not become available to the delegated task

action.reason: privileged delegate laundering: delegatee exercised standing privilege outside the delegated authority (INV-01)
